create_self_contained_model_from_trace: create a self-contained TorchScript model from a traced model using the create_self_contained_model CLI tool
create_self_contained_model_from_script: create a self-contained TorchScript model from a scripted model using the create_self_contained_model CLI tool
create_self_contained_model_from_shape: create a self-contained model by passing input shapes as JSON to the create_self_contained_model CLI
create_self_contained_model_from_data_fi: create a self-contained model by passing a saved data file path to the create_self_contained_model CLI
test_self_contained_model_wrapper: test that a wrapper-type self-contained model produces correct output and contains expected operations
